symptom: Manufacturing and Procurement saw no Released BOM in the BOM list and received Insufficient role permission when opening the Released BOM directly.
root_cause: canReadBomDraftRecordAsync unconditionally rejected released-only roles, even for immutable Released BOM records.
repair: Released-only roles may read same-company Released BOM records; lifecycle mutation endpoints use a separate management permission; read-only UI hides obsolete request and disables all editor mutations.
targeted_ui_retest: Both roles listed and opened A0042-P07 BOM Rev 30, downloaded the same CSV hash, and had no enabled mutation control.
